definitions.explanation: A person who goes on hikes, typically walking for recreation in nature, mountains, or trails. In Japanese usage, ハイカー usually refers to casual day hikers, as opposed to serious mountain climbers ({登山家|とざんか}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ハイカー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a hiker on the mountain path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハイカー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: On weekends, many hikers visit this park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦カラフル→カラフル：10803_karafuru⟧な⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハイカーたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{賑|にぎ}わせる。
examples.english: When the autumn foliage season arrives, hikers in colorful gear fill the mountains with life.

notes:
ハイカー implies lighter, more recreational outdoor walking than serious mountain climbing. Day hikes and well-maintained trails are the typical context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハイカー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: there are many hikers
- ハイカー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すれ{違|ちが}う→すれ違う：02122_surechigau⟧: to pass a hiker (on a trail)
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧ハイカー: day hiker
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧ハイカー: beginner hiker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧: mountain climber, mountaineer — a more serious hiker/climber, often for technical or high-altitude mountains
- {登山家|とざんか}: mountaineer, alpinist — a dedicated or professional mountain climber
- ⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧: hiking (the activity) — the noun for the activity itself, often said as ⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go hiking)
- トレッカー: trekker — used for longer, multi-day hiking expeditions

USAGE:
ハイカー is the person; the activity is ⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧. For longer, more demanding mountain walks, especially in the Japanese Alps, ⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧ is more appropriate.
